reviews.title: My husband has type
reviews.review_text: My husband has type 1 diabetes and I had bariatric surgery last year. We generally stay away from sugar, but were missing juice a bit. We saw this at the store, along with the mango passion, lemonade, and pink lemonade flavors. We decided to try the fruit punch and mango passion flavors. The fruit punch has a nice, subtle flavor. I compared it to a melted down sugar free popsicle, but in the best way. The mango passion has a much stronger flavor and is my favorite between the two. If you are looking for a zero sugar juice option, these are great!

reviews.title: It's OK
